committees.name: Heywood Township Planning Sub Committee
committees.note: Marked expired by the web service; holds older papers. The Middleton (133), Pennines (119) and Rochdale (134) township sub-committees are likewise expired.

committee_papers.note: Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-26. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: TYPE/YYYY/NNNN, e.g. PL/2026/0785 and OTH/2026/0876. Arcus record ids (18-character Salesforce ids) are separate and cannot be built from the reference.

browser_route.note: Open the register in a browser and search for the reference. PlanIt's applics url (…/pr/s/detail/<18-char id>) is a record deep link where PlanIt has the case.

quirks.summary: Arcus (Salesforce Experience Cloud) register with no anonymous API surface; the page is a Lightning shell, not data.
quirks.detail: bot_protection is deliberately null: nothing challenged the client. The obstacle is architectural, and the skill does not reverse-engineer the Arcus managed-package controllers.
quirks.workaround: Hand the user the browser route. PlanIt's applics url is a ready record deep link where it has one.

pacing.note: Two requests to the register host at 5 s spacing on 2026-09-26 (register page, robots.txt) with no 429 or challenge. Nothing was attempted on the Arcus controllers.

robots.note: Default Salesforce communities robots.txt: 'User-agent: *' with 'Allow: /', disallowing only the password-reset path.

verification.note: PlanIt's areas record gave the Arcus register URL on the council CNAME account.rochdale.gov.uk. One GET confirmed Arcus: Server sfdcedge and a Lightning/Aura shell with no register data. robots.txt fetched. PlanIt's applics records gave PL/2026/0785 and OTH/2026/0876 with /pr/s/detail/<id> links. No download attempted: Arcus is browser-only. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee ids.
